title: SES AI’s UZ Energy Becomes Sol-Ark® Certified Battery Partner
summary: Positions UZ Energy to Compete for Battery Sales Within Sol-Ark ® Eco-System Three UZ Energy Low-Voltage Residential Batteries Certified for Closed-Loop Compatibility US Energy Distributors Named Master Distributor and Primary U.S. Contact for UZ Energy SES AI Corporation (“SES AI”) (NYSE: SES), a global leader in the development and manufacturing of AI-enhanced high-performance Li-Metal and Li-ion batteries, today announced that UZ Energy, an SES AI company, has become a Sol-Ark® certified battery partner and has named US Energy Distributors as the master distributor for UZ Energy’s battery products in the United States. With this certification, UZ Energy is positioned to compete for battery sales within an established market from the outset and to capture market share as Sol-Ark installers, distributors, and customers evaluate new certified energy-storage configurations. “Expanding UZ Energy’s presence in the United States is an important part of SES AI’s energy storage strategy,”
